collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — NATURE, ECOLOGY AND ANIMALS (NAT-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Isola's animals, plants, tides and weather: tide pools and nesting beaches, washed-up rubbish, shrinking clam beds, strange visitors, creatures doing what creatures do, and choices about the island where nobody gets a perfect answer.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two farmers or two adults)

collection.description: Big snails nobody remembers arriving are eating the gardens: collect them every night, or find what eats them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There are snails in the gardens. Big ones, with long brown spiral shells, bigger than any snail the old villagers remember from when they were young. They come out after rain and eat everything: leaves, seedlings, even the bark off young trees. Nobody knows where they came from. (subject) and (friend) are standing in a ruined bean patch, each holding one.

choices.label: Try to Find What Eats Them

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) watches the gardens for days and notices that a certain fat brown bird snaps up the small snails. They leave bowls of water out for the birds and stop chasing them from the gardens. The birds come. They eat some snails and also some beans. It's not a solution, exactly. It's a different set of problems. Both of them agree it's slightly better than before.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) and (friend) start going out after every rain with torches and baskets. They collect hundreds. The healers say not to eat them, because nobody knows what they carry, so they're crushed and buried far away. It's slow, smelly work. The gardens recover a little. The snails keep coming. (subject) starts dreaming about snails, which is not pleasant.
